caveats: Sea cells (3311 of 3600 region cells) are those with finite SST on every day 2019-06-01..2019-08-31; land/missing cells are 0 in the mask. Thresholds/climatology per day of year from 1992-2002 baselines using +/-5 calendar-day windows (1991-12-27..2003-01-05 included), 90th percentile (hazen), day 60 filled from days 59 and 61, then 31-day centred circular moving-mean smoothing. A day is hot when SST (K) >= smoothed threshold; per-cell MHWs are runs of >=5 hot days, merged when separated by 1-2 non-hot days; regional events are maximal runs of days with at least one cell in an MHW.
